status: PROPOSED by the Chief Engineer for human agreement; NOT agreed. Binding only after a recorded human reply and a requirement update. Simulation acceptance only: passing it does not establish hardware flight performance, and every physical test remains unperformed.
prepared_by: Chief Engineer, PDR revision 5 (work plan decision af32106a18c540cb8586a4adf40ca04c r1)
applies_at: Proposed in the PDR r5 package; used to judge simulated missions at CDR after PDR acceptance.
basis: Brief (source dad529a307c94801887aed78b52a977f r1): altitude/position tolerances and touchdown limits are open requirements; tolerances must be proposed before simulated mission success is judged.
REQ-OPERATING-CONDITIONS r1: zero-payload demonstrator in calm air near sea level. No wind envelope is specified, so disturbance cases use defined synthetic forces and torques.

Screening configuration (tool_result a00d2536fcd948fe8970f44799737f2a r1): coaxial factor cases, motor-lag sweep, added-mass cases, duty/current/voltage screening limits, 15 % unused usable-energy reserve, 15 s climb and 25 s landing energy-budget durations.
Priced-BOM supplement 2026-10-03 (tool_result e87ddd0577b84f29b88beb920b926f52 r1): Hobbywing Skywalker V2 40A PWM input 50-432 Hz; MG996R 0.17 s/60 deg at 4.8 V (search-snippet grade, unloaded).
APC Thin Electric RPM limit 150000/D(in), about 11538 RPM for a 13 in propeller (tool_result 11dd3cf21e2e40ada38f311f996f7b66 r1).
REQ-HARDWARE-BUDGET r4: required reusable ground equipment is priced separately, outside the AUD 500 vehicle cap.

definitions.units: SI internally (m, s, kg, N, N m, rad); angles reported in deg, rates in deg/s, speeds in m/s.
definitions.frames: Local-level and body frames as documented in the D-PDR5-SIMULATOR-PLANT interface specification. Metrics use the logged true plant state, not controller estimates.
definitions.height: Vertical displacement of the vehicle CG above its at-rest CG height with the vehicle upright on the takeoff pad; equals landing-foot clearance when upright. Proposed reference point for REQ-HOVER-HEIGHT r1.
definitions.altitude_error: height minus the commanded height (5.0 m during the hover window).
definitions.tilt: Angle between the body thrust axis and the local vertical.
definitions.yaw_error: Heading change about the local vertical relative to the heading at arming.
definitions.horizontal_error: Horizontal distance of the CG from its at-rest position on the pad.
definitions.hover_window: Longest continuous interval after the climb in which |altitude_error| stays within the hover band of the applicable tier (TOL-MIS-HOVER-BAND), ending no later than the landing command.
definitions.touchdown_instant: First accepted integration step or detected event after the hover window at which any landing foot contacts the ground.
definitions.landed_state: After touchdown: |vertical speed| < 0.1 m/s, horizontal speed < 0.1 m/s and body-rate magnitude < 5 deg/s, continuously for 0.5 s.
definitions.usable_energy_wh: Conservative usable battery energy as defined for D-PDR5-PROPULSION-BOM: rated capacity x 0.80 usable fraction x series cells x 3.3 V minimum loaded cell voltage.
definitions.saturated_sample: A control sample at which any command is clipped by a travel, rate, duty, current or RPM limit.

tiers.nominal: Nominal CAD mass properties and selected propulsion data; coaxial thrust factors [0.90, 0.75] and torque factors [1.05, 1.15]; motor lag 0.10 s; calm air; noise-free state feedback.
tiers.robustness: Every case generated from robustness_cases, plus the sensor model if implemented; each case must meet the robustness bound.

test_conditions.control_sampling: Fixed-rate controller with zero-order hold between samples. PID integrators, derivative filters and logs update only at control samples, never inside adaptive ODE right-hand-side evaluations.
test_conditions.esc_note: Within the 50-432 Hz PWM input range if a Skywalker V2 40A class ESC is selected.
test_conditions.servo_note: 50 Hz analog-servo frame and unloaded MG996R speed; placeholders until the gimbal rate is measured through the linkage under load.
test_conditions.gimbal_note: Provisional maximum tilt of the coaxial unit from the body axis (Chief assumption in plan af32106a).
test_conditions.sensor_model_robustness: Optional until altitude and position sensors are selected: white noise with sigma 0.05 m on height and horizontal position, 0.2 deg on attitude and 0.5 deg/s on body rates, plus one control-period latency. Placeholder values.
test_conditions.integration: solve_ivp or a documented fixed-step method with max_step no greater than the control period; solver status checked for every segment; ground contact handled by events or a documented contact model.

scenarios.S-TRIM: Start in hover at 5.0 m with zero rates and the collective initialised at the weight estimate; run 20 s; evaluate t = 10-20 s.
scenarios.S-QUAT: Torque-free plant check over 10 s, plus every closed-loop scenario.
scenarios.S-ATT: From hover at 5.0 m: initial tilt of 10 deg about pitch, about roll and about the 45 deg diagonal with zero rates; and zero tilt with a 30 deg/s initial pitch rate.
scenarios.S-ALT: From hover at 5.0 m: +1.0 m and -1.0 m height-command steps.
scenarios.S-DIST: From hover at 5.0 m: D1 horizontal force step of 0.05 x weight at the CG for 2 s; D2 pitch and roll torque pulses of 0.10 N m for 0.2 s; D3 yaw torque step of 0.01 N m for 2 s.
scenarios.S-SAT: From hover at 5.0 m: SAT1 +3.0 m height-command step that saturates collective or climb-rate limits; SAT2 initial tilt of 20 deg with a 60 deg/s rate that saturates the gimbal; SAT3 pitch torque of 1.5 x the hover gimbal authority (hover thrust x pivot-to-CG distance x sin(gimbal travel)) for 0.3 s.
scenarios.S-MISSION: Upright on the pad with motors idle: arm, take off, climb to 5.0 m, hover until the hover window reaches 300 s plus a 5 s margin, descend, touch down, detect the landed state and disarm.

robustness_cases.selection: Short scenarios (S-TRIM, S-ATT, S-ALT, S-DIST, S-SAT): full factorial over thrust factors x torque factors x motor lag x added mass (54 cases), with inertia scale, CG offset, servo lag and control period varied one at a time from nominal. S-MISSION: nominal, each parameter varied one at a time, plus a worst corner (thrust [0.85, 0.65], torque [1.05, 1.15], motor lag 0.20 s, added mass 0.30 kg, inertia 1.2, servo lag 0.10 s) and a light corner (thrust [0.95, 0.85], torque [1.0, 1.0], motor lag 0.05 s, added mass 0.0 kg, inertia 0.8).

logging_and_evaluation: Log at every control sample: time, the 13-element state, mission phase, commands before and after saturation, saturation flags, integrator states, rotor speeds, motor and ESC currents, pack current and terminal voltage, cumulative energy, gimbal angles and the differential-torque command.
An editable verifier computes every metric from the logged artifacts and prints only VerificationResult JSON through verify_command; process exit status is not evidence.
Report the measured value and margin for every tolerance and every case, not only pass or fail.
Simulation results are evidence of simulated behaviour only. Coaxial factors, motor/ESC lag and servo dynamics remain uncalibrated until ground tests are performed.

sources_consulted.title: ArduPilot Copter documentation, Land Mode
sources_consulted.observed: Below LAND_ALT_LOW_M (default 10 m) the copter descends at LAND_SPD_MS, which defaults to 50 cm/s. Landing is detected when, for about one second, the motors are at their lower limit, throttle is minimum, the roll/pitch target is below 15 deg, attitude error is below 30 deg, downward acceleration is below 1 m/s^2 and vertical speed is within 1 m/s of zero.
sources_consulted.use: Context for the proposed 0.5 m/s final-descent and touchdown limits; not a requirement.

sources_consulted.title: PX4 User Guide, Land Detector Configuration
sources_consulted.observed: Ground-contact state requires no vertical movement (LNDMC_Z_VEL_MAX), no horizontal movement (LNDMC_XY_VEL_MAX) and low thrust, persisting for 300 ms (900 ms without distance-sensor data); maybe-landed adds rotation below LNDMC_ROT_MAX. Default values were not shown in the extracted text.

sources_consulted.title: PX4 User Guide v1.13, Land Mode
sources_consulted.observed: MPC_LAND_SPEED is the rate of descent during landing and should be kept fairly low; the extracted text does not state its default.

sources_consulted.title: PX4 Discuss, Slower landing speed?
sources_consulted.observed: A search summary reports a 0.7 m/s default MPC_LAND_SPEED and a 0.6 m/s minimum; the forum page was not inspected.

questions_for_human.question: Accept the nominal and robustness tolerances in this file as the simulated-mission acceptance criteria for CDR, or state changes.
Measure the approximately 5 m hover height as CG displacement above its at-rest height on the pad (foot clearance when upright), with hover bands of +/-0.25 m nominal and +/-0.50 m robustness?

Under the minimum-structure correction, is a propeller guard not required on the vehicle, with test safety provided by a tether, an exclusion zone and a restraint priced as reusable ground equipment outside the AUD 500 vehicle cap?
questions_for_human.chief_proposal: No on-vehicle guard; ground safety equipment priced separately.

questions_for_human.question: Use these structural design cases: L1 maximum available thrust with full gimbal deflection plus servo stall-torque reaction; L2 hard landing at 1.0 m/s vertical (twice the 0.5 m/s touchdown limit) with first contact on one leg at 5 deg tilt; L3 tip-over from rest with motors stopped, battery and electronics remaining retained. Factors of safety 2.0 on ultimate strength for 3D-printed polymer parts and 1.5 for metal or carbon-fibre parts; minimum rotor-to-structure clearance 10 mm at maximum gimbal deflection.
